A '''sonic agitator''' was a device once used by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to draw a legendary [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] called the [[White Terror]] out of its [[Ice Claw Wampa Den|lair]] to kill it.
